propositions: Plan review must independently classify each acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested based on where its completion evidence truthfully lives, not just detect keywords

Externally verifiable criteria lacking the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag, or carrying malformed near-misses, must produce findings that name the correct syntax; exact tags on external criteria must be accepted
Codebase-verifiable criteria carrying [operator-attested] must produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; untagged codebase criteria must be accepted
Mixed-evidence criteria that bundle both repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned one kind; the system must require splitting into independently certifiable criteria
High-confidence evidence-classification findings must participate in blocking policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open

The frozen-corpus evaluation must achieve 100% precision on external negatives, 100% recall on named A1/115b/8c4f/malformed/over-tagged fixtures, and ≥0.90 macro precision/recall across all samples with zero regression on previously passing fixtures
